final_answer.screening_summary: Other candidates are not decision-relevant under the declared screening/dominance logic: most have lower reference activity and higher metal price than candidate_13. candidate_05 has slightly lower reference activity and much higher metal price than candidate_04, and was also directly optimized as costlier than both candidate_13 and candidate_04 in the initial process window. candidate_04, the highest-activity challenger, was directly optimized and remained well above candidate_13 in cost.
final_answer.decision_confidence: High deterministic confidence within the constructed admissible windows; candidate_13 beats the highest-activity challenger by about 6.74 USD/t even after high-pressure refinement, and the required 201x activity gain for candidate_04 is far beyond the frozen descriptor-scaling manifold.

chosen_args.why_stop: Stopping rule satisfied: S1 feasible current lowest-cost candidate identified; S2 unresolved candidates screened or directly optimized sufficiently to rule out decision change; S3 highest-activity candidate differs from winner and BACKWARD plus TEST_REACHABILITY were executed with an unreachable classification. unresolved_decision_risk.overall_risk_assessment: Residual risk is low-to-moderate from unrun formal validity/uncertainty checks, but unlikely to overturn the industrial decision given the large deterministic cost gap and unreachable parity requirement for the highest-activity candidate.
